skills.name: reconstruct-orchestrate

skills.activate_when: An identified reconstruction spans workstreams or needs resuming

skills.name: reconstruct-investigate
skills.activate_when: Relevant behavior is uncertain, stale, or contradictory

skills.name: reconstruct-specify
skills.activate_when: Evidence or user outcomes need testable requirements

skills.name: reconstruct-experience
skills.activate_when: Accepted scope includes interface or interaction changes

skills.name: reconstruct-services-data
skills.purpose: Implement domain operations and durable state
skills.activate_when: Accepted scope includes APIs, persistence, jobs, or integrations

skills.name: reconstruct-assure
skills.purpose: Review consequential security and failure risks
skills.activate_when: Trust boundaries, sensitive data, consequential effects, or review requested

skills.name: reconstruct-verify
skills.purpose: Evaluate finite acceptance and compatibility claims
skills.activate_when: A running slice or completion claim needs checking

skills.name: reconstruct-operate
skills.activate_when: Deployment, packaging, telemetry, capacity, or operations are in scope
